evidence.quote: The PostgreSQL Global Development Group supports a major version for 5 years after its initial release.

evidence.quote: The PostgreSQL Global Development Group supports a major version for 5 years after its initial release. After this, a final minor version will be released and the software will then be unsupported (end-of-life).
